---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible behavior and the evidence needed to fix it
---

## Reproduce

Route or command, exact steps, and a minimal input. Include run/revision when relevant.

## Expected and actual

What should happen? What happened instead?

## Evidence

Sanitized error or screenshot; failing check; relevant `npm run doctor` results.
Include the commit, OS, Node version and browser when relevant. Distinguish the
deterministic scenario, Commons and Language lab; state whether inference was real
or mocked. Never attach credentials, cookies, databases, private prompts or runtime
exports. For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead.

## Acceptance example

The observable behavior that proves this bug is fixed.
